name: Матова атака (1)
description:
In this lesson we will go straight for the king again. We will bombard the enemy king with a direct checkmate attack. These checkmating attacks are becoming increasingly complex. Sometimes you need a combination to generate threats.

If the opponent does manage to set up a defensive line, be satisfied with winning material.

What do you have to do?

Give checkmate or win material by means of a direct checkmating attack.

examples.text: Black can win spectacularly with 1...Bxg2!! If white recaptures, black has checkmate.

examples.pgn: 33... Rxc2 34. Bxc2 Qxc2 35. Qb8+ Kh7 36. Qe5 Qg2# *
examples.text: This one is more complicated. Black can very strongly sacrifice the exchange on c2. The tandem of bishop and queen is so strong that checkmate cannot be avoided.

examples.pgn: 48... Bg5 {[%csl Yf4,Rg3,Gg5]} 49. Nc5 Bf4+ {[%csl Ga2,Gf4,Rg3]} 50. Kh3 Rh2# {[%csl Gf4,Gf5,Gh2,Rh3]} *

texts: How will White cover the mate on g2? This will cost a queen.
Create a deadly mate threat and consider possible defenses by White.
